title: Eric Hecker's childhood involvement with the Stargate program
summary: Eric Hecker tells of Eric Hecker's childhood involvement with the Stargate program, about Hecker's childhood at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I grew up on Long Island. Um I had a very peculiar history uh of nefarious activity with uh the Stargate program.

plain: Eric Hecker, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says he grew up on Long Island, New York, and as a child was caught up in what he calls nefarious activity tied to Stargate, a US government programme that tested psychic abilities. He describes his history with it as very peculiar. If true, it would mean children were drawn into secret government psychic work.
